dct_description_sm: The National Forest Inventory is a monitoring system that produces information concerning national and regional forest resources (volume, growth and quality of growing stock), land use structure and forest ownership, forest health, biodiversity of forests and forest carbon stocks and their changes. Also in Sub-Arctic area.  Specific monitoring variables: - forest resources - volume, growth and quality of growing stock, - land use structure and forest ownership, - forest health, - biodiversity of forests and - forest carbon stocks and their changes.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Industries
dct_title_s: National forest inventory (VMI) of Subarctic and Arctic Finland
